briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Basis:** Search results only. No outside information added.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Deals**
- A wire item dated 15 Nov 2026 reports that a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, per people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The item does not name the target.** Do not assume it is Databricks until this is confirmed. The domain is also unfamiliar, so treat the item as low-confidence.
- Commvault announced "Data Activate for Databricks," a planned governed-data solution with early access in December 2026 in select Azure regions. It is not yet generally available (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai, 10 Nov 2026).

**Product launches**
- On 11 Nov 2026, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents).
- Databricks unveiled an updated Genie that can handle multi-step jobs taking extended time (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-d5ce8d4f2e7d567c6d43a125_databricks-_genie_gives, 11 Nov 2026).
- Databricks launched agentic tools that run in the background and proactively assist workers. A separate "Ontology" feature scans organizational data (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html, 12 Nov 2026).

**Corporate and facilities**
- Databricks opened its new San Francisco headquarters at One Sansome, spanning 10 floors and over 200,000 square feet. The company plans to double its headcount by 2027 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/databricks-san-francisco-headquarters-ai-office-22525207.php, 11 Nov 2026).
- Databricks has no announced IPO date. Its private valuation is reported at $190 billion, with annualized revenue above $7 billion (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options, 25 Oct 2026).

**Hires**
- I could not find any hiring or leadership changes in the results.

**Other**
- A Solutions Review roundup for the week of 6 November lists "Updates from Databricks," but the results contain no details (https://solutionsreview.com/business-intelligence/analytics-and-data-science-news-for-the-week-of-november-6-updates-from-databricks-ocient-smartsheet-more).

## Open questions

1. Is Databricks a party to the Globex Corporation agreement reported on 15 November, and if so, what are the terms and expected closing timeline?
2. Genie plugins now reach four major AI agents, and results can still be truncated for very large queries. What guidance should customers follow for large-scale use, and when will the Genie One MCP server and updated Genie be generally available?
3. With headcount set to double by 2027 and Commvault's Azure-region early access planned for December, what is Databricks' roadmap for partner integrations and regional availability?
